title: crepis occidentalis var. pumila
intro: Crepis occidentalis var. pumila, commonly known as Western Hawksbeard, is a small, hairy perennial plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Western Hawksbeard include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of Western Hawksbeard include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
